messages:
Rohit: quick post-launch triage thread  need to split 4 items into bug vs enhancement and decide sprint placement. short on time so bullets only.

Lea: paste the items pls

Rohit: from support + telemetry:
```
RD-11001  embedding vector mismatch for multi-page PDFs (CustP)
RD-11012  streaming reorder when retries kick (CustQ)
RD-11030  console: prompt editor loses cursor in mobile safari (multiple customers)
RD-11055  routing: fallback to smaller model increases latency unexpectedly (internal)
```

Gabe: my read  RD-11001 looks like a regression -> bug P0 (large customer). RD-11012 intermittent infra edge -> P1 mitigation. RD-11030 UX polish but high NPS so quick patch if low risk. RD-11055 sounds like policy/routing bug with perf regression.

Tara: ops note  RD-11012 traces show retries reorder chunks when proxy retries arrive out-of-band. low-risk mitigation is adding an ingest-seq header and buffer reorder for 24-48h. full fix touches pipeline.

Ivy: PM: CustP flagged RD-11001 as blocker for their onboarding. if we push RD-11001 into sprint 1 we need an owner and a clear acceptance criteria to promise ETA.

Rohit: proposal:
- Sprint 1 (2w): RD-11001 hotfix (owner: Lea) + repro/test in harness; RD-11012 mitigation as ops config flip (owner: Tara); tiny UX patch RD-11030 if it doesn't risk mobile release.
- Sprint 2: RD-11055 routing rollback/spike and full postmortem if routing policy change caused perf.

Lea: I can take RD-11001. estimate 3 dev-days + 1 qa day. acceptance: failing reproducer added to harness, unit/regression test, 5% canary 24h, customer verification from CustP.

Gabe: for RD-11055 spike we should capture histograms pre/post routing change and be prepared to roll back the policy on a metric threshold.

Tara: I'll open config PR for RD-11012 mitigation now and list affected customers. low-risk deploy to staging today.

Ivy: PM ask  can someone draft two short customer notes: CustP (hotfix ETA) and CustQ (mitigation + monitoring). keep tone: "we're on it; ETA: hotfix in this sprint / mitigation live now and we'll follow up with results."

ScopeBot: Ticket RD-11100 created by Rohit: "post-launch split  RD-11001 hotfix + RD-11012 mitigation + RD-11030 patch"

Lea: will open feature branch and attach reproducer by EOD tomorrow.

Gabe: I'll prepare rollback plan and metric gates for RD-11055 spike.

Tara: staging run scheduled; will post logs to triage channel.

Ivy: I'll draft the two customer notes and post to the support thread after Lea confirms ETA.

Rohit: vote check  react +1 if you agree with sprint split.

Lea: +1

Gabe: +1

Tara: +1

Ivy: +1

Rohit: great. I'll update the sprint board and move one low-priority enhancement out to make room. follow-up in weekly roadmap review.
